summary: 8/8 acceptance criteria exercised. 2 backend test files (5 tests) + 3 browser checks, all passed. One self-corrected test-authoring mistake (wrong expected badge text) fixed in-place without needing a re-run, since the environment's shared daily submission allowance (3/day/IP) was deliberately spent on this single comprehensive flow.
action_items: Note: the public-facing daily allowance (3 starts/UTC day per session+IP) is a hard, shared resource across all test traffic hitting this environment's egress IP. Only 1 slot remained at the start of this iteration; it was spent on the `full-story-discovery-flow` browser check so all 7 UI-facing story/recap/discoveries criteria could be verified against a real live-AI run in a single pass. Any future iteration on the same UTC day will need to wait for UTC rollover (or accept fallback/limited coverage) before re-exercising the live submission path.
